review.notes: IP audit 2026-10-23: captured by the spikes' Playwright scripts (or by hand) from the project's own procedural UI; no third-party art, logos or fonts embedded (system UI fonts only). The S4/I1/I2 captures showed green/red/yellow/blue/orange lanes close to Guitar Hero's fret colours (issue #12). 2026-10-23, #12: s4-autoplay.gif, s4-ultra-4k.png, s4-low-1080p.png, i2-4-ringers-play.png, i2-4-ringers-lobby.png, i2-2-phones-plus-host-play.png and i2-phone-controller.png re-captured with the pitch-class palette (same scripts: s4-web-host/scripts/bench.mjs + capture-gif.mjs, i2-web-phones/scripts/e2e.mjs --shots + controller-check.mjs --shots). I1-data/controller-yarg-lanes.png keeps YARG's lane colours (ADR-0008 interop exception); spikes/s1-phone-bell/results/zones-pixel-viewport.png predates #12 (S1 hue-wheel colours, not a fret order; hand capture on a phone). 2026-10-24, seating chart: i2-seating-lobby.png (TV lobby) and i2-phone-part-picker.png (S1 phone page, Pick your part) added under the same CC BY 4.0 decision for screenshots of our own UI, captured by spikes/i2-web-phones/scripts/seating-e2e.mjs --shots (pitch-class palette, system fonts and emoji only). 2026-10-25, drop-in joining + practice speed: i2-ingame-join-qr.png (TV during a song: corner join QR, +1 waiting, 50% speed badge), i2-results-join-qr.png (results screen with the corner QR) and i2-phone-waiting.png (S1 phone page, You're in!) added under the same CC BY 4.0 decision, captured by spikes/i2-web-phones/scripts/dropin-e2e.mjs --shots (the QR encodes a private LAN test address; pitch-class palette, system fonts and emoji only).
